comments: TrueConform is deliberately audit-first: it reports what automated testing can verify and explicitly does not claim to make sites compliant. It never injects overlays or widgets into evaluated sites.
features: Honest, audit-first accessibility checker built on axe-core. Scans single pages or whole sites against WCAG 2.1/2.2 A/AA, grades them A–F, and explains every issue in plain language with fix guidance — in 8 languages. Includes monitoring, PDF compliance reports and an EAA/EN 301 549 accessibility statement generator. No overlay.
title: TrueConform
